caption:
8 flags, 1 gate, 0 second chances. Flag Drop · Race #3 is live.

Argentina, the UK, France, Australia, Mexico, Korea, Spain and Japan tumble through pegs, zigzag ramps and glowing bumpers. Only the UK has raced this course before, the lead keeps trading hands on the way down, and the bottom line gets settled in slow motion.

Early leader or late charger: which flag has your back?

#marblerace #worldflags #flagrace #gravityrace #physicsfun
